selection_scope: All twelve shareable built-in sources and all their currently available physical thresholds. Private uploads are excluded. Previously published result versions are preserved. Not the full experimental corpus.
checks: Every WAV byte-identical to source API
PCM16 original minus processed equals difference sample for sample
Threshold-zero original and processed WAVs identical
Strict metadata allowlists and private-data pattern scan
Recorded stage events monotonic and sequence-complete
Previously published result, audio and replay assets remain byte-identical
